explanation: This unit is active only while the agent has been choosing a1 and is 0 at every step while it is choosing a2: in an a1 streak, D1 after an unrewarded trial is 10 (only about 3-4 if the trial before that was also unrewarded with a common transition), the D2 that follows is 4-6, and D1 after a rewarded trial is 0 (occasionally 5-7 just before switching to a2). GO and other D2 steps in an a1 streak sit at 1-3, a bit higher after a rewarded D1 (about 2-3) than after an unrewarded one (about 1).
